Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made a factual error in Step 2 by stating that the season pass price for California's Great America in 2024 is $99. This price is incorrect; the actual season pass price is significantly higher (typically over $130-$140 for adults in 2024). Consequently, this erroneous data led to an incorrect calculation of savings ($81 instead of the actual savings of roughly $60-$70). While the DataVerification_Expert failed to catch this, the root cause of the wrong solution lies in the extraction of false information by the InformationExtraction_Expert.
